author: Cynthia Rylant, Jill Kastner
video_title: IN NOVEMBER - by Cynthia Rylant & illustrated by Jill Kastner | Read-Aloud
description:
🍂As autumn deepens and the air grows crisp, the world begins to slow—settling into the quiet beauty of change. In November by Cynthia Rylant invites readers to pause and notice the gentle transformations of the season: birds migrating south, animals finding warmth, and families gathering close around shared meals and glowing fires.

Paired with Jill Kastner’s gentle, glowing illustrations, Rylant’s poetic words remind readers to appreciate simple joys: the smell of pies baking, the comfort of home, and the calm beauty of the changing seasons. A perfect story to read together on chilly days or around the Thanksgiving table.

📚 Age Group: 4–8 | Kindergarten to 3rd Grade
🎯Themes: Family and Gratitude, Changing Seasons, Nature and Home, Comfort and Connection, Autumn to Winter

description:
🍂 Leaf Man by Lois Ehlert | Read Aloud Story for Kids 🍁

Where is Leaf Man going? No one’s quite sure — because a Leaf Man’s got to go where the wind blows! Join us for this beautifully illustrated autumn tale by Lois Ehlert, filled with vibrant leaf collages and the gentle rhythms of nature. As Leaf Man drifts past marshes, meadows, and fields, young readers are invited to imagine their own leaf creations and follow the adventure wherever the breeze may take them.  

Perfect for fall, this story sparks creativity and wonder, making it a seasonal favorite in classrooms and cozy reading nooks alike.  

🎵 This video includes two versions of the story:
1. 🌞A bright, upbeat read-aloud set to lively music — perfect for daytime listening, classroom fun, or storytime.  

2. 🌛A calm, soothing version with gentle music — ideal for winding down or bedtime.

author: Linda White, Megan Lloyd
video_title: TOO MANY PUMPKINS - by Linda White & illustrated by Megan Lloyd | Read-Aloud
description:
Get ready for a heartwarming fall tale with Too Many Pumpkins by Linda White! 🎃🍂

Meet Rebecca Estelle, who really doesn’t like pumpkins. So when a giant one splats in her yard, she buries it—only to find herself surrounded by a sea of pumpkins the next autumn! What will she do with too many pumpkins? Maybe a little creativity and kindness can turn a problem into a celebration!

Illustrated by Megan Lloyd, whose charming artwork also brings to life The Little Old Lady Who Was Not Afraid of Anything—her expressive, whimsical style adds warmth and fun to every page!

A cozy seasonal classic with delightful illustrations, and a message about giving—it’s a fall storytime must-read!

🚌 Ideal for ages: 4–8
✏️ Perfect for: Preschool, Kindergarten, 1st Grade, 2nd Grade
📚 Themes: Fall, Generosity, Community, Problem-solving

author: Ralph Fletcher
video_title: Hello, Harvest Moon - by Ralph Fletcher illustrated by Kate Kiesler | Read-Aloud
description:
🌕As twilight deepens and the first stars appear, the harvest moon rises—bright, round, and full of quiet magic. Hello, Harvest Moon by Ralph Fletcher invites readers into a serene nighttime world, where shadows stretch long and the stillness of the evening wraps everything in wonder.

Paired with Kate Kiesler’s rich, atmospheric oil paintings, this poetic story captures the quiet majesty of a fall night. Each page glows with the soft, golden light of the moon, beautifully complementing Fletcher’s lyrical text. Together, words and images create a dreamy portrait of the world after dark—perfect for bedtime or a cozy autumn read-aloud.

📚 Age Group: 4–8 | Kindergarten to 3rd Grade
🎯 Themes: Night and Nature, Autumn and the Moon, Observation and Wonder, Poetic Language, Stillness, Imagination, Seasons, Fall Harvest
